2. The INDEX/MATCH pattern `INDEX(Data!Range, MATCH(SeriesCode, Data!SeriesCol, 0), MATCH(Year, Data!HeaderRow, 0))` correctly retrieved the values from the Data sheet.
3. The weighted mean was correctly implemented using `SUMPRODUCT(Values, Weights) / SUM(Weights)`.
4. Future tasks involving statistical functions in openpyxl should always check for the `_xlfn.` prefix requirement.
